clips.title: 美国住房事务负责人谈降低居住成本
title_lines: 监管松绑与信贷渠道并进
title_highlights: 监管松绑与信贷渠道并进

subtitles.en: Mr. Secretary, welcome back to Bloomberg TV and radio.
subtitles.zh: 部长先生，欢迎再次来到彭博电视和广播。

subtitles.en: You are joining us on a day at which, once again, we saw yields climbing, borrowing costs, are just moving higher and higher.
subtitles.zh: 您今天加入我们之际，我们再次看到收益率攀升，借贷成本越来越高。

subtitles.en: How do you get mortgage costs down for the American people so long as the bond market is saying there is a serious fiscal and inflation problem
subtitles.zh: 只要债券市场表明存在严重的财政和通胀问题需要解决，您如何为美国人民降低抵押贷款成本？

subtitles.en: that needs to be dealt with?
What can I appreciate that? And thank you for having me again. It's always great to be with you all.
subtitles.zh: 我能理解吗？感谢再次邀请我。很高兴与大家在一起。
en_highlights: thank you for having me again

subtitles.en: And as you alluded to, you know, the president made the promise when he came in and all of us in the administration to get the cost of housing down.
subtitles.zh: 正如您提到的，总统上任时做出了承诺，我们政府所有人都要降低住房成本。

subtitles.en: And a big part of that was the regulatory environment to cut the red tape, to cut the bureaucracy, not only from the federal government standpoint,
subtitles.zh: 其中很大一部分是监管环境，减少繁文缛节，削减官僚作风，不仅从联邦政府角度，

subtitles.en: but also from our localities standpoint. And so at HUD, for instance, we took down the affirmatively further and fair housing rule, which really made HUD a national zoning board
subtitles.zh: 也从地方角度。例如，在HUD，我们取消了肯定性进一步公平住房规则，这实际上使HUD成为国家分区委员会

subtitles.en: during the Biden and Obama administration. So we were sending that rule to restore local control back to our states and localisers.
subtitles.zh: 在拜登和奥巴马政府期间。因此我们发送该规则以将地方控制权归还给各州和地方。

subtitles.en: And also the president signed two new executive orders, one to reduce the barriers to build an affordable house and then two to increase the mortgage and the credit market.
subtitles.zh: 此外，总统签署了两项新行政命令，一是减少建造经济适用房的障碍，二是增加抵押贷款和信贷市场。

subtitles.en: So that the hometown lender, the community bank, the credit unions, if you will, could get back into the mortgage game, which they've been really out of that game since Dodd Frank
subtitles.zh: 这样本地的贷款机构、社区银行和信用合作社就能重新参与住房抵押贷款业务，而他们在多德-弗兰克法案之后基本退出了这一领域。
en_highlights: get back into the mortgage game

subtitles.en: to help our local and hometown people, and particularly people in rural development.
subtitles.zh: 来帮助本地居民，尤其是农村地区的发展。

subtitles.en: And so you take down bureaucratic red tape, the deregulation and increase in the credit market.
subtitles.zh: 因此，减少官僚程序、放松监管并增加信贷市场供给。

clip_research.source_claim: HUD Secretary Turner says the administration is cutting regulatory barriers to bring down housing costs, including rescinding the affirmatively furthering fair housing rule and signing two executive orders.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public records confirm two executive orders signed in March 2026: one on removing regulatory barriers to affordable home construction and one on promoting access to mortgage credit.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The clip presents these actions as ongoing efforts to reduce housing costs, while public records show the executive orders were signed in March 2026, which may be after the interview date.

evidence.fact: Turner mentions rescinding the affirmatively furthering fair housing rule and two executive orders.

evidence.fact: Executive Order 14394 on removing regulatory barriers to affordable home construction was signed in March 2026.

evidence.query: Trump executive order mortgage credit market 2025
evidence.fact: Executive Order 14393 on promoting access to mortgage credit was signed in March 2026.

forbidden_claims: Turner is dishonest about housing costs
The executive orders were signed before the interview
The fair housing rule rescission directly caused lower housing costs

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
